edits.old: No service table is read and no value is invented.
edits.new: No service table is read and no value is invented. Stored documents are asserted through the P5 contract of rwb-document, cases through the P3 contract and party keys through the P1 customer contract, and the decision record is read on `rwb.decision-record.v1`; the central ledger is proved in this story. Each service creates its local decision-record table in its own schema through the decision-record library, with the case reference and the trace ID carried in inputsRef; the table name and DDL are settled in the DB story of each service. Each service chains its own records in chain_seq order, the central ledger chains its entries on ingest, the daily WORM fingerprint covers the ledger chain, and the chain of record is the ledger, with the local chain kept for replay.
